a 200 on the shell is not evidence of data access - the probe therefore records this source as UNAVAILABLE rather than verified
consequence: a Chinese UDI-DI cannot be resolved, so the Chinese market cannot be joined to GUDID by device identifier
research_value: The Chinese UDI database would be the only way to tie a China-registered device to a DI, i.e. to link Mindray's Chinese registrations to its US GUDID listings. As it stands the Chinese side stays unmatched, which is a real limitation on any within-firm cross-market identity claim for Mindray.
